content.about.heroTitle: A Legacy of Building Homes with *Trust*
content.about.heroText: Quality construction, thoughtful design and lasting relationships — the foundations of every Jayashri home.
content.about.intro: Jayashri Construction & Developers is a construction and real estate development company based in Satara, Maharashtra. We build residential homes, bungalows and villas, and take projects from planning and approvals through construction to handover.
content.about.story: Jayashri Construction & Developers was founded with a simple vision — to create strong, beautiful and lasting homes for families. Over the years, we have grown with the trust and support of our clients, delivering spaces that combine quality construction, thoughtful design and the warmth of a true home.
content.about.vision: To be a trusted and preferred construction brand known for quality, innovation and customer satisfaction.
content.about.mission: To design and build homes and spaces that are safe, durable, aesthetically pleasing and add lasting value to our clients' lives.

services.title: Residential Construction
services.shortDescription: Custom homes designed for comfort, style and long-term value.
services.description: We build independent homes from foundation to finishing, planned around your family, your plot and your budget. Every stage is supervised by our engineers, with quality materials and regular progress updates.

services.title: Bungalow Construction
services.shortDescription: Spacious, elegant bungalows with modern amenities and timeless design.
services.description: From traditional tiled-roof bungalows to contemporary designs, we create spacious homes with verandas, gardens and the craftsmanship that makes a bungalow feel special.

services.title: Villa Development
services.shortDescription: Premium villas designed for peaceful and luxurious living.
services.description: We develop premium villas and villa communities with considered planning, generous spaces, quality specifications and lasting value.

services.title: Project Development
services.shortDescription: End-to-end residential project planning, execution and delivery.
services.description: We take residential projects from feasibility and design through approvals, construction and handover, managing every contractor and milestone along the way.

services.title: Construction Services
services.shortDescription: High-quality construction with skilled execution and timely delivery.
services.description: Contract construction services for owners who already have plans: structure, masonry, finishing and services, delivered by experienced site teams.

services.title: Architectural Planning
services.shortDescription: Functional, aesthetic and site-optimised home designs.
services.description: Our planning team turns your requirements into practical floor plans, elevations and working drawings that make the most of your plot.

services.title: Land Development
services.shortDescription: Land acquisition support, layout planning and development for residential spaces.
services.description: We help plan and develop land for residential use, from layout design and roads to utilities and plot demarcation.

reviews.content: They helped us with planning and approvals for our plot and explained everything clearly.
